description_en: Modifies the auto-renewal status of a ClickHouse Community-Compatible cluster
description_zh: 修改Clickhouse社区兼容版集群的自动续费状态
kebab_example: aliyun clickhouse modify-auto-renew-attribute --db-cluster-ids cc-bp1uy5ff600000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2019-11-11 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyAutoRenewAttribute

parameters.help_en: The cluster ID. To specify multiple cluster IDs, separate them with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh:
集群ID。
如果有多个集群ID，以英文逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: db_cluster_ids

parameters.help_en:
The renewal method. Valid values:

AutoRenewal: Auto-renewal.

Normal: Manual renewal.

NotRenewal: The cluster is not renewed after it expires
parameters.help_zh:
续费状态。取值：

AutoRenewal：自动续费；

Normal：手动续费；

NotRenewal：到期不续费
parameters.name: renewal_status

parameters.help_en:
The renewal duration. The default value is 1.

If you set \`PeriodUnit\` to Month, valid values are integers from 1 to 11.

If you set \`PeriodUnit\` to Year, valid values are 1, 2, 3, and 5.

A longer subscription period offers a better price. For example, a one-year subscription is more cost-effective than a 10-month or 11-month subscription
parameters.help_zh:
续费时长。默认值为1。

当PeriodUnit为Month时，取值为1~11（整数）。

当PeriodUnit为Year时，取值为1、2、3、5（整数）。
购买的时间越长价格越优惠，购买1年的实际价格会比购买10个月或11个月更划算
parameters.name: duration

parameters.help_en: The unit of the renewal duration specified by the \`Duration\` parameter. Valid values: Month and Year
parameters.help_zh: 续费时长的时间单位，即参数Duration的单位。取值范围：Month，Year
parameters.name: period_unit
